annotations.title: Create, change or delete a queue

description: Create a queue or change its settings (lease, max_attempts before dead letter, max_messages), or delete it with all its messages (delete: true).

delete.description: true: delete the queue and its messages.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

max_attempts.description: Claims before a message goes to the dead letters.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

queue.description: Queue name: 1 to 64 characters from a-z 0-9 . _ -.

name: queue_settings
